summary: A November 1950 Tampa Tribune list names a staffed Hurrah tower at Hurrah Church; a 2008 auction sale is the only later record, and no source describes the site today.

events.note: Listed as 'Hurrah tower, at Hurrah Church', seven miles south of Pinecrest, with Kenneth Pace as towerman.
Sold at auction, per the Forest Lookouts page. Buyer, seller and the tower's later condition are not stated.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The lookout list uses Hurrah; Wikipedia's article is titled Picnic and says the community is also known as Hurrah. Both are treated as the same place name.

notes_for_editor: The 1950 Tampa Tribune entry and the 2008 auction note both come from the Forest Lookouts page alone, with no second source. Mapcarta and Wikipedia give location only. Build date, design, height, agency and the tower's present condition are not in any source found. The story is 99 words, below the 120-word floor, because the evidence does not support more. Hurrah Church itself was not separately read; the church's position is only as the Mapcarta listing gives it. The brief's status 'unknown' is still correct. Fact-check 2026-10-21: the November 13, 1950 date, Hillsborough County and Tampa Tribune attribution were confirmed on the Forest Lookouts page and added to the evidence; the Mapcarta 620-foot figure was given an explicit referent (of the tower), taken from the Nearby Places listing.
